hero.title: Blink the infrared sky to discover moving worlds
hero.subtitle: Enter any star, brown dwarf, or sky coordinates. Watch SPHEREx images from different dates animate so motion and brightness changes jump right out.
hero.expertCoordsHint: Supports object names (SIMBAD/Sesame), decimal degrees (133.795 -7.245), or HMS/DMS (08h55m10.8s -07d14m42s).

howItWorks.title: How it works in 3 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Title: 1. Pick or search a sky patch
howItWorks.step1Desc: Type a target name or coordinates, or pick one of the featured objects below.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Images from multiple observation dates are aligned to one grid and animated smoothly.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Turn on Diff mode or Gaia arrows to see nearby objects shift and variable stars pulse.
